newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel FELS wins US$60 mln rig contract.
newsitem.headline: Keppel FELS wins US$60 mln rig contract.

text.p: Keppel FELS said on Wednesday a subsidiary has won a drilling rig construction contract worth more than US$60 million, its second such new contract this year.
AMFELS Inc, the U.S.-based wholly owned subsidiary of Keppel FELS, signed the contract with Chiles Offshore of Houston, Texas, to build a LeTourneau Super 116 clas jack-up drilling rig.
The rig will be built under a licence agreement with LeTourneau Inc, a unit of Rowan Companies.
It will be classed by the American Bureau of Shipping and is expected to be delivered in the second half of 1999.
Keppel FELS is a unit of Singapore's Keppel Corp Ltd.
